comments.author: Bael
comments.body: This quest doesn't have any requirements. As as clicked on the Mediator the quest was already there for me, I did help someone else get it as he had the same problem. Maybe Italian is a must? try it. Good luck.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I found it without Italian. If you get the 'no quests found' message, keep trying. It might take more than one QMP spam, even on targeted QMP searching. Remember, cities like London offer 100+ adv. quests, so some misses for a specific quest are to be expected. Cheers.
